Performers
Michael Laucke (guitar; arranger) Documented

The file title names the performer; the summary credits his Commons account Mlaucke and describes his arrangement.

[1]
Work version
Michael Laucke’s arrangement for solo guitar Documented

The performer’s description says the arrangement retains the piano original’s notes within six strings. This is the arranger’s statement, not an editorial note-by-note certification. Pitch-class comparison with the D-major piano recording supports a transposition to A; exact guitar voicings and octaves have not been score-aligned.

[1]

Unknown Unknown

Commons gives 23 July 2001 as the work/file date, but does not explicitly identify it as the session date. The listening page preserves it only as a source date; the 19 November 2015 upload is not a recording date.

[1]
Processing
FLAC source; Wikimedia Commons MP3 access derivative Documented

No original editing or mastering procedure is documented. Playback is unchanged. For comparison only, tools/compare.py rotates the guitar’s chroma features by five semitones upwards (--transpose-b -5); this changes neither the stream nor its time axis.

[1]
Composition rights
Public-domain underlying piano composition, as stated on Commons Documented

The page’s PD-because explanation concerns Satie’s death in 1925. It does not dedicate Laucke’s performance or arrangement to the public domain.

[1] [3]
Recording rights
CC BY-SA 4.0 International Documented

Accepted under the recording-licence rule. The copyright-holder declaration explicitly releases this work under CC BY-SA 4.0; Commons records VRT permission ticket 2016052310032124. The API’s Public domain summary conflates the composition tag with the recording and is not used as the recording’s licence.

[1] [2]

Erik Satie, Gymnopédie No. 1; arranged and performed by Michael Laucke (Mlaucke). Source date 23 July 2001; session date not established. Via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0; streamed without editorial audio alteration. Rights statement
